scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the high-level error (MSB3073, signing failure, project name, target name) but failed to dig deeper into the specific details - particularly which file failed to sign and what the actual error reason was (access/permission). The agent made only one follow-up call to get task details but didn't explore further to find more granular information about the failure. The speculative 'likely causes' list is generic rather than informed by actual binlog data.
